posts.title: 💻 System programming languages
posts.description: Earlier this year, I posted my preliminary thoughts on Odin . Since then, I finished reading Karl Zylinski’s Odin book and the Odin compiler got noticeably faster . Odin isn’t the only language I considered, and due to a bout of uncertainty, I continued evaluating the alternatives. C What could be more handmade than choosing C and writing my own standard library (data structures, allocators, etc).
